say:1:1910609001:1.text: I'm going to fetch something for Garnet. You all can rest nearby, but don't make a sound.
say:1:1910609001:1.source_cn: 我去给歌尼特取东西，你们可以在附近休息，但不要发出响声。

say:2:1910609002:1.text: Mister Calix, is this... your home?
say:2:1910609002:1.source_cn: 卡律先生，这里就是……你家？

say:3:1910609003:1.text: It's totally different from Coralia. It's so shabby here.
say:3:1910609003:1.source_cn: 和塔拉萨真是两副景象，真够简陋。

say:4:1910609004:1.text: My people have always dwelt in caves. Besides, this place was abandoned long ago. Thanks to that maddening sound...
say:4:1910609004:1.source_cn: 我的族裔本就栖居岩洞，况且这里早被废弃了。呵，拜那种令...

narration:7:1910609006:1.text: As if by magic, Calix turns sideways and slips into the narrow mouth of the cave.
narration:7:1910609006:1.male: As if by magic, Calix turns sideways and slips into the narrow mouth of the cave.
narration:7:1910609006:1.female: As if by magic, Calix turns sideways and slips into the narrow mouth of the cave.

say:9:1910609007:1.text: Whoa! That was crazy! He actually squeezed through that tiny opening.
say:9:1910609007:1.source_cn: 奇了，他竟然能钻进去，洞口那么窄。

say:10:1910609008:1.text: 没有螺屋，也没有饲藻和阳光，水压如此巨大冰冷，他们是怎么生存的呢？
say:10:1910609008:1.source_cn: 没有螺屋，也没有饲藻和阳光，水压如此巨大冰冷，他们是怎...

say:11:1910609009:1.text: Can we look around? I'm curious about Mister Calix's kin and the daily lives of the Deepfolk. They are so like us yet so different.
say:11:1910609009:1.source_cn: 可以在附近转转吗？我很好奇卡律先生的族裔，还有深海裔平...
